description: Ipswich Road Network is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ipswich City Council. Dataset showing road centrelines including Local, State and Federal roads. Indicates maintenance responsibility and road heirarchy description. Extents within the City of Ipswich. Coverage: Ipswich City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Ipswich City Council. Its tags are Infrastructure, Ipswich City, Road Hierarchy, Roads. It offers 7 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, SHP, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
